rows.grounds: absolutive of prakalp, indicating completed construction before the main action
fused accusative place with indeclinable thus; no @ marker in supplied token
feminine nominative singular pronoun referring to the goddess
locative singular of compound vṛtta+bhūmi, indicating location of standing

items.question: How does the goddess establish herself after constructing the place on the round earth?
items.inference: The goddess's self-standing follows the construction of the place.
uncertainties: token sthānamevaṃ is fused without an @ sandhi marker
items.plain_english: Having constructed the place thus, she herself stood on the round earth.
